text: A failed TLC result's message keeps SANY's error diagnostics, with their source locations, in printed order before TLC's closing line (#450). On #445, a draft whose model didn't parse came back with only 'Parsing or semantic analysis failed.', and a drafting round went to finding the misindented line by hand: SANY prints its errors outside TLC's message frames, and the parser kept only framed text. Now the formalizer's feedback, the receipts and the factory's failure posts say which line broke and why. Routine parsing and progress lines stay out, and Printed, outcome classification and every other failure's message are unchanged. Checked against the pinned TLC on an unknown operator, a syntax error and #445's indentation error.
